items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa2hUIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--aaa08f452192183cc190f1119549fd736a5ba99d/dS5SYCl.png) Welcome to Manila Sides Standoff 2024, Cubers and Friends's first organized competition in the Philippines, and get ready to clash your side puzzles together! This competition features the side events **Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1, Clock, and 3x3 Multi-Blind**, with **Pyraminx** as the main event. Given the speciality of this competition towards side events, time limits and cutoffs for majority of the events are lower than your usual competition, so this competition is more recommended for cubers looking for a challenge. If you are looking for a more typical competition experience, feel free to check out [other competitions happening in the Philippines.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Philippines&search=&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list) NOTE: As the venue's size is limited, competitors may bring **at most 1 guest** to spectate. However, additional guests per competitor may spectate at a fee of **Php 300 per additional guest**. Competitors are also encouraged to have their lunch **before** the competition, as **there will be no lunch period** as scheduled. For more information regarding guest and venue guides, please refer to their respective tabs above.

organisers.name: [{Leonardo Sánchez Del Toro}{mailto:leotorokr@gmail.com}] [{Sergio Humberto Chávez Velarde}{mailto:shchv91@gmail.com}]

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjQ4ODQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--70dda75542644ea0af198d4bbc96659f421ae2ba/Maza%20(1).png) ###### Español: ¡Bienvenidos al “Mano Salada Mazatlán 2025”, la primera competencia oficial en el hermoso estado de Sinaloa! ¡Con el majestuoso océano pacífico a tus espaldas, el “Mano Salada Mazatlán 2025” promete ser el torneo con la vista más espectacular desde tu estación de competidor! Reunirá a cuberos de todo el noroeste del Pacífico mexicano y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en una variedad de modalidades y categorías. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos participen y se diviertan. Esta competencia está organizada por el Sinaloa SpeedCube Team y el Team Nayarit. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el reglamento de la WCA antes de la competencia. ###### Inglés: Welcome to “Mano Salada Mazatlán 2025,” the first official competition in the beautiful state of Sinaloa! With the majestic Pacific Ocean at your back, “Mano Salada Mazatlán 2025” promises to be the tournament with the most spectacular view from your competitor station! It will bring together cubers from all over the northwestern Pacific region of Mexico and beyond, giving them the chance to showcase their skills and compete in a variety of events and categories. Whether you’re a beginner or a seasoned pro, this tournament offers an opportunity for everyone to participate and have fun. This competition is organized by the Sinaloa SpeedCube Team and Team Nayarit. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association (WCA) event. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the WCA regulations prior to the competition.

items.name: Markham 3x3x3 Afternoon 2023
items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## Markham 3x3x3 Series 2023 One day, two competitions! We are running two competitions as part of Markham 3x3x3 Series 2023: [morning](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Markham333Morning2023) and [afternoon](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Markham333Afternoon2023). You will only be able to compete in ***one*** of these two competitions. ***Attempting to register for both of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.*** This is a great opportunity to compete in 3x3x3 Cube – the maximum-allowed top-75% of competitors will advance to the second round! ### Registration Reminders You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. Please see the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### No Food or Drink Cornerstone Church does **not** allow food or drink inside the gymnasium. Please consume any food or drink outside the venue or off-site. ### Mailing List We are aware of the extremely high demand for competitions in Ontario. We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand and are regularly planning and announcing more and larger competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. Thank you for your patience during this time as we work to scale up to the exciting growth of the cubing community. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information: Master Cube HCMC 2026 will be organized on December 12th and 13th 2026 with 150 competitors limit at AEON HALL (3rd floor AEON MALL TAN PHU CELADON). From January 2nd, 2027, WCA's competitions will switch to using a 4-pad mode timer instead of 2-pad as before. Therefore, this is the last WCA competition in Ho Chi Minh City using a timer in 2-pad mode. And this competition will be held by cubingHCM team. Giải đấu Master Cube HCMC 2026 sẽ được tổ chức vào ngày 12-13/12/2026 với 150 thí sinh tại hội trường AEON HALL (lầu 3 AEON MALL Tân Phú Celadon) Từ ngày 02/01/2027, giải đấu của WCA sẽ chuyển sang sử dụng timer ở chế độ 4-pad thay vì 2-pad như trước đây. Vì vậy, đây là giải đấu WCA cuối cùng sử dụng timer ở chế độ 2-pad tại Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh. items.name: Matatipac Open 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBckdEIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--f5052380d4840da25b42fdc99bf608f4ab05e628/Matatipac%20Open%202024%20(1).png) ###### Español ¡Bienvenidos al **Matatipac Open 2024**! Esta emocionante y dinámica competencia se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de Tepic el sábado 17 y domingo 18 de agosto de 2024. El Matatipac Open 2024 reunirá a cuberos de todo el estado de Nayarit y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en una variedad de rompecabezas tridimensionales, principalmente eventos no cúbicos. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos participen y se diviertan. La competencia incluirá una ronda de Face-Turning Octahedron (FTO), un evento no oficial que promete ser muy emocionante. Además, esta competencia está reconocida oficialmente por la Asociación Mundial del Cubo (WCA). Por lo tanto, es importante que todos los competidores estén familiarizados con el reglamento de la WCA antes de la competencia. ###### English Welcome to the **Matatipac Open 2024**! This exciting and dynamic competition will take place in the city of Tepic on Saturday, August 17, and Sunday, August 18, 2024. The Matatipac Open 2024 will bring together cubers from all over the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in a variety of three-dimensional puzzles, primarily non-cubic events. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced professional, this tournament offers a chance for everyone to participate and have fun. The competition will include a round of Face-Turning Octahedron (FTO), an unofficial event that promises to be very exciting. Additionally, this competition is officially recognized by the World Cube Association (WCA). Therefore, it is important for all competitors to be familiar with the WCA regulations before the competition.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjM0NzgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--7f38aa440f2f5ea4ba0f22de16d4f6cdf4c47946/IMG-20250124-WA0034.jpg) ​ ##### Español ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ¡Bienvenidos a **Mega-Mente Puebla 2025**! Puebla se prepara para recibirte en un torneo que pondrá a prueba tus habilidades y conocimientos. **¿Qué tan lejos puede llegar tu mente?** El nombre del torneo y nuestra categoría principal no son coincidencia. Cada detalle ha sido pensado para resaltar la conexión entre la fuerza mental y el desafío que representa este evento. El Megaminx, con su forma dodecaédrica, representa un verdadero desafío para la mente, exigiendo combinar estrategia, eficiencia, precisión, visión espacial y velocidad. Así es como Megaminx se convierte en el corazón de este torneo, acompañado de otras categorías desafiantes que pondrán a prueba tu mente. Esta competencia es posible gracias al apoyo del Presidente de **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Claudio Bañuelos**. Mega-Mente Puebla 2025 es una competencia oficial de la WCA, por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/). ​ ##### English ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Welcome to **Mega-Mente Puebla 2025**! Puebla is ready to welcome you to a tournament that will challenge your knowledge and skills. **How far can your mind go?** The name of the tournament and our main category are no coincidence. Every detail has been carefully designed to highlight the connection between mental strength and the challenge this event represents. The Megaminx, with its dodecahedral shape, embodies a true mental challenge, demanding a combination of strategy, efficiency, precision, spatial awareness, and speed. This is why the Megaminx becomes the heart of this tournament, accompanied by other challenging categories that will put your mind to the test. This competition is made possible thanks to the support of the President of **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Claudio Bañuelos**. Mega-Mind Puebla 2025 is an official WCA competition, so all competitors must be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations).

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk0NjcyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d276ee4a1432869c38d809b8802b47006f609e10/Megamente_2026.png) # Español Hay desafíos que no se vencen solo con velocidad; se dominan con la capacidad de visualizar lo que otros no pueden. **Megaminx** es una prueba de estrategia, creatividad y control bajo presión. Es el eje de esta competencia. Pero **Mega-Mente** es mucho más que un solo rompecabezas. Cada categoría ha sido seleccionada para ponerte a prueba. **¿Tienes lo necesario para adaptarte a cualquier desafío?** Porque no importa qué tan rápido gires un cubo. Lo que importa es... **qué tan lejos puedas llevar tu mente.** #### **¡BIENVENIDOS A MEGA-MENTE PUEBLA 2026!** ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Esta competencia es posible gracias al apoyo del Presidente de **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Juan Carlos Quiroz**. Mega-Mente Puebla 2026 es una competencia oficial de la WCA, por lo que **todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/)**. ​ **AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA** En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad. 📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/ # English ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Some challenges can't be conquered by speed alone; they are mastered through the ability to visualize what others cannot. **Megaminx** is a test of strategy, creativity, and composure under pressure. It is the centerpiece of this competition. But **Mega-Mente** is much more than a single puzzle. Every event has been carefully chosen to challenge you. **Do you have what it takes to adapt to every challenge?** Because it doesn't matter how fast you can turn a cube. What matters is... **how far you can push your mind.** #### **WELCOME TO MEGA-MENTE PUEBLA 2026!** ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ This competition is made possible thanks to the support of the President of **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Juan Carlos Quiroz**. Mega-Mente Puebla 2026 is an official WCA competition, so **all competitors must be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations)**. **NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY** Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice. 📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

items.information: Ceci est la 184ème competition sur le sol Français, autant de compétitions auquelles a participé François Courtès, décédé en 2016. Il a grandi à Montpellier. Cette compétition sera un hommage en son honneur. **Hommage :** si vous souhaitez faire un discours ou partager des photos (même si vous n'êtes pas présents à la compétition), contactez [Clément Cherblanc](mailto:ccherblanc@worldcubeassociation.org). Pensez à consulter les onglets, en particulier celui du [planning](#competition-schedule) et du [plan d'accès](#13873-comment-y-acceder-how-to-access). Merci également de **lire attentivement les conditions d'inscription**. L'épreuve principale de cette compétition est le 3x3 à l'aveugle. ---- This is the 184th competition in France, as many competitions as François Courtès attended, before he died in 2016. He grew up in Montpellier. This competition is a tribute in his honor. **Memorial:** if you would like to make a speech or share photos (even if you are not attending the competition), please contact [Clément Cherblanc](mailto:ccherblanc@worldcubeassociation.org). Make sure to read the information in the tabs, especially the one with the [schedule](#competition-schedule) and [access plan](#13873-comment-y-acceder-how-to-access). Also, **please read the registration requirements carefully**. The main event of the competition is 3x3x3 Blindfolded.

items.information: Välkomna till Mental Breakdown Landvetter 2025! Detta är en lite annorlunda tävling, med bara de mer avancerade grenarna som på årets SM kommer ha kvalgränser. Här är alltså en utmärkt chans att kvala in till dem! Därmed är det inte en tävling som typiskt sett passar nybörjare, men om men är flink på att lösa med ögonbindel eller FMC så är man givetvis varmt välkommen oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. ----- Welcome to Mental Breakdown Landvetter 2025! This is a slightly different competition, with only the more advanced events that will have qualification limits at this year's Swedish Championship. So here is an excellent chance to qualify for them! That also means it is not a competition that typically suits beginners, but if you are good at blindfolded solving or FMC, you are of course welcome regardless of previous competition experience. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. [![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

Dette er en WCA-konkurranse som fokuserer på de fem mest krevende eventene vi har: FM, 3-blind,4-blind, 5-blind og multiblind. Dette er den første av sitt slag i Norge. Alle som ønsker å delta er velkommen, men siden eventene er ganske krevende, så vi regner med at de fleste som kommer har deltatt på konkurranse før. Legg merke til at vi ikke konkurrerer i vanlig 3x3 i denne konkurransen! Legg også merke til at vi kun godtar opp til 30 deltakere.

items.information: Registration Fee: There is a **$20** registration fee for the event, payable through the WCA Stripe payment system. Please note that even after payment, registrations need to be manually approved before appearing on the registration list, so you may still not be fully confirmed immediately after payment. Please keep an eye out for the e-mail saying you have been approved. Registration is on a first-come first-serve and the same will go for the waitlist once registration fills up. Please do not register unless you intend on competing as it will open up a spot for another competitor who does intend on competing. **We will only be accepting online payment at this competition. If you have any issues with this, please contact us!** There is a **25 competitor limit** to the competition. Please register as soon as possible if you plan on coming! Registration closes at the end of the day on July 7th. We will grant refunds to those who let us know by July 7th, but no refunds are granted after that date. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, you may want to look at [CubingUSA's Competitor Tutorial](https://www.cubingusa.com/ctutorial.php). Join the PNW Facebook group to hear about competitions in the Pacific Northwest before they are announced and keep in touch with cubers in the area! From beginners to experienced cubers, there will be something for everyone. Get ready to challenge your skills and meet other cube lovers! # Rules and Regulations Make sure to review the official WCA rules and regulations before the championship. Let the fun begin and may the best cuber win!

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTMwMjMzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a88be8e562f5ebba28fb00b6d150321631e6d031/BANNERArtboard%202%20copy.png) **Español** **¡Bienvenidos a Mexzingo Open 2025!** Te esperamos en el primer torneo oficial de speedcubing en Mexicaltzingo, que se llevará acabo en el "Salón de usos múltiples del palacio municipal", San Mateo Mexicaltzingo, Estado de México, este 29 de Noviembre. Thank you to the Municipal Government of San Mateo Mexicaltzingo for making this event possible. This competition is recognized as an official WCA competition, so all competitors must be familiar with the Regulations.

items.name: Mid Summer Madness Cape Town 2024

venue.name: [Kirstenhof Primary School](https://goo.gl/maps/ibUsNtD2otafVyrp9)
venue.details: School hall and entrance hall for registration

items.information: [CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce the first Cape Town competition for 2024. Dust off your cubes and get ready to set some PB's - or even records! Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, **and** make payment by buying a ticket. Please see **Registration Requirements** below. ### SPECTATORS Competitors are welcome to bring 2-3 spectators with them. Please let us know if you need to accommodate more spectators. ### VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). ### SPONSORSHIP ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbU10IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--03db2d12875f7b21e073b29649b48a5bc813b0e2/image.png) A big thanks to [Speedcubes](https://www.speedcubes.co.za/) who are sponsoring vouchers as a part of the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to try out and buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. ### LUCKY DRAW During prize-giving after 3x3 Finals on Sunday, we will be having a Lucky Draw for two winners to receive R250 Speedcubes.co.za vouchers each with free shipping on their order! If you needed another reason to stick around and watch 3x3 Finals other than the amazing speed of some of Africa's top speedcubers, maybe you could be one of the lucky winners and walk away with some free cubes or apparel courtesy of our local speedcubing store. #### About CubingZA CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. In 2024, we are anticipating being able to host one competition every season in each of the cities of Cape Town, Johannesburg, and Durban, as well as other regular events in Pretoria, Bloemfontein, Limpopo, and more! If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to bring competitive speedcubing to the country, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact).

items.name: Mimosa Mall Master Cubers 2023

venue.name: Mimosa Mall
venue.details: Open floor area set up in a shopping mall

items.information: [CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce the Mimosa Mall Master Cubers 2023 speedcubing competition! This competition will focus on a variety of shorter, popular events, several of which have never been held in Bloemfontein before. Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, **and** make an EFT payment to confirm your entry. Please see **Registration Requirements** below for the banking details and when registration opens. ### Masters and Challengers This competition will recognise the performance of both established cubers and relatively new competitors - if you have never been to a competition before, or come from the Free State and your only other competition you have attended was Mimosa Mall Master Cubers 2022 (last year's competition), then you qualify as a Challenger. All Challengers will be able to qualify for their own prizes and podium places. Otherwise, if you have attended at least 2 competitions before, you are a Master Cuber and will be competing against some of the best in the country for the top prizes! ### All New Competitors If this is your first time competing, or the first time your child or ward is competing, please ensure to bring with ID (card, book, passport, birth certificate) so that we can verify that the name is spelled correctly, the Date of Birth is correct, and the Nationality is correct. Please also ensure you have all the puzzles you need to compete - we do not supply puzzles for competitors. You are welcome to ask other competitors if you can borrow their puzzle for a certain event, but there is no guarantee. If you need a puzzle before the competition, check out www.speedcubes.co.za, www.cubeco.co.za, or https://cubestuff.co.za/ to order your puzzles before the comp. ### Spectators As this is a public venue in a shopping mall, any spectators can attend for free. Please be aware that there will be arranged seating specifically for parents and guardians of competitors, but this will be limited. ### Volunteering Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). ### Sponsorship Massive thanks to Mimosa Mall for sponsoring this competition. As part of the sponsorship, they are providing the venue free of charge, as well as all of the competition sound/video equipment we will need and assisting with setup, advertising, and of course, providing a very generous amount of prize money for the winners! ### Lucky Draw During prize-giving after 3x3 Finals on Saturday, we will be having a Lucky Draw for two winners to receive R250 Speedcubes.co.za vouchers each with free shipping on their order! If you needed another reason to stick around and watch 3x3 Finals other than the amazing speed of some of Africa's top speedcubers, maybe you could be one of the lucky winners and walk away with some free cubes or apparel courtesy of our local speedcubing store. #### About CubingZA Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact). We are particularly looking for help with communications, and graphic design.

items.information: Mind Games 2017 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. Aiming to a good fluence for the competition, at registering for a event, you compromise to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in the other you'll help as staff.

items.information: Even if you choose to pay the day of the competition, you still need to pre-register. Registration closes on July 5th. items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzYzOTcsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--40d6a92906ae7958b380fe38d926638d59b4dabd/MIRA%20LABS%20LOGO%20COLORED.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc4ODcsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--b16871971da44f65ec3100f26afb9b425073d72e/CITYMALL%20MINI%20BANNER.png) Mira Labs is excited to announce our inaugural WCA competition, **Mira Labs Cubing Scientists in Bacolod 2025**! items.name: Mississauga Blindfolded 2024
items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## Please Be Quiet This isn't your typical speed solving competition as ***blindfolded events*** are the only events. Blindfolded events require a significant amount of learning, practice and concentration. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to please remain quiet at this competition to allow competitors to concentrate. If you are looking to compete in the traditional 3x3x3 Cube event or other timed events, please look for [another competition in Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada). ## FMC Canada 2024 We will take a break in the middle of the day to hold [FMC Canada 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCCanada2024) at the same venue. You may compete in both competitions, but **you must register for each competition separately**. ## Note for New Competitors Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles blindfolded (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you. You can also follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ## Registration Reminders You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ## Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjM2MTksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--b23596ced59378ad4a8ac06a151c6ca2d99f14b7/LOGO.png) # **Mix & Match at McDo Lacson 2025** ### *The First-Ever WCA-Sanctioned Competition Held at McDonald's in the Philippines* Mira Labs, in collaboration with McDonald's Lacson, is thrilled to announce this unique speedcubing event! --- ## **Event Highlights** - **Main Events:** - 3x3x3 and 2x2x2 Cubes, featuring **three exciting rounds each** to determine the ultimate champions. - **Inclusive Perk:** - Each competitor will receive a **McDonald's Meal**, complete with food and drinks, which is free already if you registered—a first-of-its-kind in Philippine Cubing history! ## **Event Details** This competition is open to cubers of all ages and skill levels. venue.name: [Ánsar Cirko](https://maps.app.goo.gl/2wnQb4ki2Ec8r4av5)
venue.address: Calle Dr Martínez #225, San Antonio, 63159 Tepic, Nayarit, Mexico

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa1ZsIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3c6e9fe6551a0ccb8658afed67be40e057fe6ac2/Mololoa_logo.png) ###### Español ¡Bienvenidos al Mololoa Open 2024, la **segunda competencia oficial** en el hermoso estado de **Nayarit**!. Este evento emocionante y lleno de velocidad se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de Tepic los días sábado 23 y domingo 24 de marzo de 2024. El Mololoa Open 2024 reunirá a cuberos de todo el estado de Nayarit y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en una variedad de eventos. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos participen y se diviertan. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. ###### English Welcome to Mololoa Open 2024, the **second official competition** in the beautiful state of **Nayarit**! This exciting and high-speed event will take place in the city of Tepic on Saturday, March 23, and Sunday, March 24, 2024. Mololoa Open 2024 will bring together cubers from across the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them with the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in a variety of events. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced professional, this tournament offers a chance for everyone to participate and have fun. This competition is recognized as an official event by the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk4MjA5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--972806504f8e67211ebc816281b9ddf1b8bf11e5/MOLOLOA.png) ###### Español ¡Bienvenidos al Mololoa Open 2026, otra competencia en el hermoso estado de **Nayarit**!. Este evento emocionante y lleno de velocidad se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de Tepic los días sábado 29 y domingo 30 de agosto de 2026. El Mololoa Open 2026 reunirá a cuberos de todo el estado de Nayarit y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en una variedad de eventos. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos participen y se diviertan. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. **AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA** En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad. 📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/ ###### English Welcome to Mololoa Open 2026, another competition in the beautiful state of **Nayarit**! This exciting and high-speed event will take place in the city of Tepic on Saturday, Aug 29, and Sunday, Aug 30, 2026. Mololoa Open 2026 will bring together cubers from across the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them with the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in a variety of events. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced professional, this tournament offers a chance for everyone to participate and have fun. This competition is recognized as an official event by the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. **NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY** Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice. 📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaVZJIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6d98ad7fe7955c2fd2e99d497670f8462f289e13/image.png) **Español** Es un placer darles la más cordial bienvenida a Montealegre Winter 2023. En esta tercera edición, nos reunimos nuevamente en el prestigioso Teatro Montealegre para celebrar nuestra pasión compartida por este desafiante rompecabezas de colores. Tendrán la oportunidad de demostrar sus habilidades, aprender de los mejores y, sobre todo, disfrutar de un día inolvidable rodeados de personas apasionadas como ustedes. No importa si es tu primera vez participando en un campeonato o si ya eres un veterano de la resolución de cubos, ¡Todos son bienvenidos! **English** It is a pleasure to welcome Montealegre Winter 2023. In this third edition, we meet once again at the prestigious Teatro Montealegre to celebrate our shared passion for this challenging color puzzle. You will have the opportunity to demonstrate your skills, learn from the best and, above all, enjoy an unforgettable day surrounded by passionate people like you. Whether it's your first time participating in a championship or you're already a veteran solving Rubik's cubes, everyone is welcome!

items.information: Español: La competencia Bisiesto Open 2020 será la cuarta edición que se llevará acabo en este local. Leer el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes. Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad, a nuevos y viejos competidores y sin importar los tiempos de resolución. Los acompañantes de los competidores no tiene que pagar ningún tipo de entrada ni inscripción. Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento, de acuerdo al artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento. Por favor tengan también en cuenta los artículos [3a](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#3a) y [3a1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#3a1). English: The Bisiesto Open 2020 competition will be the fourth edition that will take place in this venue. Read the [regulations of the WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid possible issues. This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age. Guests do not have to pay any type of entry or registration. Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with article [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the regulations. Please also take into account articles [3a](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#3a) and [3a1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#3a1).

items.information: # 🇺🇾 NO SE DEBE ASISTIR A LA COMPETENCIA CON SÍNTOMAS DE LA ENFERMEDAD COVID-19. Hay un límite de 40 competidores para el registro. * Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes. * Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución. * Recomendamos que se asista con **máximo un acompañante**, ya que no podemos asegurar que haya suficientes lugares para que todos se puedan sentar. * Se debe tener en cuenta que el Delegado de la WCA puede descalificar a cualquier competidor cuyo comportamiento constituya un riesgo para la salud de los demás. items.information: (BR) **Bem-vindos à segunda competição oficial de Morro Reuter!** Enquanto a maioria das pessoas viaja às praias no verão, a ideia de trazer a população cubista para um lugar calmo e tranquilo na Serra Gaúcha deu origem ao Morro Reuter em Colônia 2024! A oferta dessa competição é para aproveitar o período de férias longe do stress e tumulto das praias e grandes centros urbanos, trazendo desafios em Gincana interativa, com atividades que desenvolvam o trabalho em equipes e a melhor interação entre os competidores, especialmente crianças do Sul do Brasil. Nos vemos lá! (EN) **Welcome to the second official competition in Morro Reuter!** While most people travel to the beach during the summer, the idea of bringing the speedcubing community to a quiet and peaceful place in tthe Gaucho highlands gave birth to *Morro Reuter em Colônia 2024*! The proposition of this competition is to take advantage of the holiday season, far from the stress and chaos of the beaches and great urban centres, bringing challenges in an interactive contest, with activities that develop teamwork and the best interaction among the competitors, especially the children from Southern Brazil. See you there!

items.information: 🇧🇷 **Português:** O valor da taxa de inscrição é *R$35,00* e deve ser pago de forma antecipada via pix para gabrielrcosta021@gmail.com. O comprovante deve ser enviado para o mesmo email gabrielrcosta021@gmail.com juntamente do nome completo do competidor. A inscrição só será aceita após o recebimento do comprovante juntamente do nome completo do competidor. A inscrição demonstra o compromisso de participação do competidor, e é utilizada para planejamento e organização do campeonato. Por isso, o valor não é reembolsável. Pedimos que não se inscreva em modalidades que não pretende participar. # ATENÇÃO: Para adentrar a universidade é necessário preencher o formulário abaixo e ler a aba "INFORMAÇÕES" # Link do formulário: https://forms.gle/etNqqgt2cw4NjK5f7 Dicas: - Chegue ao local da competição pelo menos 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado; - Você é responsável pelo seu cubo e seus pertences, cuide deles. Não nos responsabilizamos por perda de cubos mágicos e outros pertences durante a competição; 🇬🇧 **English:** The registration fee is *R$35.00* and must be payed in advance via PIX to gabrielrcosta021@gmail.com. The payment receipt must be sent to same email gabrielrcosta021@gmail.com along with the competitors full name. The registration will only be accepted after the receipt and the full name of the competitor have been received. Registration demonstrates the competitor's commitment to participate and is used for the planning and organization of the competition. For this reason, the fee is non-refundable. We kindly ask that you do not register for events you do not intend to compete in. If payment via PIX is not possible please contact us by email # **ATTENTION: To enter the university you must fill out the form below and read the "INFORMATION" tab** Form link: https://forms.gle/etNqqgt2cw4NjK5f7 Tips: - Arrive at the competition location at least 30 minutes before the category you will participate in; - The cube you will compete with must be in good condition; - You are responsible for your cube and your belongings, take care of them. We are not responsible for the loss of cubes and other belongings during the competition;

items.information: ## Змагання в підтримку України #### Будемо раді бачити як і новачків, так і професіоналів. Уся актуальна інформація по змаганнях буде у [чаті змагань](https://t.me/MriyDiyCubingLviv) тут ви можете і задавати свої питання по змаганнях. #### Всі не витрачені з реєстрації кошти будуть передані у благодійний фонд [Повернись Живим](https://savelife.in.ua/) ## Competitions in support of Ukraine #### We will be glad to see both beginners and professionals. All the latest information about the competition will be in the [competition chat] (https://t.me/MriyDiyCubingLviv), where you can also ask your questions about the competition. #### All unspent registration fees will be transferred to the charity fund [Come Back Alive] (https://savelife.in.ua/)

items.information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [WCA Competition Tutorial] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf). There is a one guest limit for this competition due to the size of the room. This also means that no outside spectators will be allowed. Join our [Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/2382471798653473/) to get notified when future competitions in the area get announced and to socialize with other speedcubers! This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).
